name: remove_track
description: Adds a Remove Track button: skips the current track and deletes the file from disk, MPD queue, Volumio queue, history and playlists.
author: karkolom223

volumio_info.details: Adds a Remove Track button to the Contemporary UI. It skips the current track and deletes its file from disk, the MPD queue and database, the Volumio queue, history, favourites and playlists.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.0.0 - initial release, port of the manual 'Volumio Remove Track v1.4' setup
